Opening `/widgets/` shows page not found (404) instead of loading the page (200).

### How to fix it

Put addresses in a standard form before the part that matches web addresses to pages compares them. This is expected to make `/widgets/` load. The fix is small and safe. Choose hotfix because the fix is small and safe.
